name: Kyukyu College
description: Kyukyu College is an editorial magazine-style WordPress theme designed for paramedic colleges, emergency medical schools, and clinical training institutions. Built around a refined tetsu-kon navy palette with crisp hairline frames and dynamic serif typography, it showcases pre-hospital education through structured course timelines, scenario simulations, and transparent fee schedules. The theme features dedicated block patterns for clinical diploma programmes, frontline ride-along placement tracking, and open campus visits.
